dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you really have to be so vigilant with logistics work, too?

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: Of course. While logistics work may appear to be happening only far from the frontlines, every single supply run is crucial to the battle's outcome.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: These supply runs are critical not just for the lives of our soldiers, but for the people they’re protecting as well. It's all in our hands, really.

dialogues.speaker: Gabieta
dialogues.text: That's why I can't allow even the smallest mistake.
